shortDescription: This module manages remote support assistance configuration on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the list of unique names for the support center or proxy to be defined. Required when I(support=remote), to enable remote support assistance.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: sra_ip
options.description: Specifies the list of IP addresses or fully qualified domain names for the new support center or proxy server. Required when I(support=remote) and I(state=enabled), to enable support remote assistannce.

options.name: sra_port
options.description: Specifies the list of port numbers for the new support center or proxy server. Required when I(support=remote) and I(state=enabled), to enable support remote assistannce.

options.name: state
options.description: Enables (C(enabled)) or disables (C(disabled)) the remote support assistance.

options.name: support
options.description: Specifies the support assistance through C(remote) or C(onsite).

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
